items.name: 伸展上背部拉伸
items.description: Reaching your arms out as you round your upper back stretches the muscles between and around your shoulder blades.

items.name: 站姿上举背部旋转拉伸
items.description: Reaching one arm up and rotating your trunk stretches the lats and the muscles around your spine. It also gives your mid back some rotation.

items.name: 上举背部拉伸
items.description: Reaching both arms up and slightly back lengthens the lats and upper back. A simple stretch to open your sides.

items.name: 仰卧全身拉伸
items.description: Lying flat and reaching long through your arms and legs gives your whole body a gentle stretch. A nice reset after training.

items.name: 双手悬挂背部拉伸(用肋木)
items.description: Hanging from wall bars with both hands lets gravity stretch your lats and decompress your back. Great after heavy pulling days.

items.name: 绳索悬吊背部拉伸
items.description: Holding a cable attachment, you lean back and let your weight stretch your lats and back. Good for opening up the upper body.

items.name: 单臂背阔肌拉伸
items.description: Reaching one arm overhead and leaning to the side stretches a single lat. Good for finding tight spots on each side.

items.name: 侧向背阔肌拉伸
items.description: Bending sideways with an arm overhead lengthens the lat and the side of your trunk. A quick stretch for the flanks.

items.name: 坐姿下躯干伸肌拉伸
items.description: Seated and folding forward, you stretch the muscles along your lower back. A gentle way to ease lower back tightness.

items.name: 坐姿下躯干伸肌侧屈肌拉伸
items.description: Seated, you fold forward and sideways to stretch both the lower back and the side of your trunk. It targets one side at a time.

items.name: 坐姿俯身背部拉伸
items.description: Sitting and bending over lets your upper body hang to stretch your whole back. A relaxed stretch to release tension.

items.name: 坐姿侧伸拉伸
items.description: Seated, reaching over to the side stretches your lats and obliques. It is easy on the hips and good for desk breaks.

items.name: 盘腿坐姿前伸拉伸
items.description: Sitting cross-legged and reaching forward opens your lower back and hips. It is a calm stretch that suits cooldowns.

items.name: 后倚下躯干伸肌拉伸
items.description: Lying on your back and pulling your knees in stretches your lower back and hips. A soothing option after long periods of sitting.

items.name: 坐姿并脚前伸拉伸
items.description: Sitting with your soles together and reaching forward stretches your back and inner thighs. A gentle hip and back opener.

items.name: 仰卧膝碰胸拉伸
items.description: Pulling one knee toward your chest while lying down stretches your glutes and lower back. A classic, easy hip release.

items.name: 站姿膝碰胸拉伸
items.description: Standing on one leg and hugging the other knee to your chest stretches your glutes and tests your balance. A good warm-up move.

items.name: 跪姿背部旋转拉伸
items.description: Kneeling on all fours and rotating through your trunk mobilises and stretches your mid back. Slow and controlled works best.

items.name: 站姿背部旋转拉伸
items.description: Rotating through your trunk while standing stretches your back and obliques. It is a quick way to loosen up your torso.

items.name: 肘屈肌拉伸

items.name: 前臂旋前肌拉伸
items.description: Rotating your forearm outward stretches the muscles that turn the palm down. Handy for anyone who types or lifts a lot.

items.name: 手臂垂直伸展拉伸
items.description: Arms stretched out vertically open up the front of the arm and shoulder. It lengthens the biceps and chest.

items.name: 支撑物上手臂拉伸
items.description: Resting your arms on a support and sinking down stretches the biceps and front of the shoulders. The support does part of the work for you.

items.name: 旋后握杆悬吊拉伸
items.description: Hanging from a bar with palms facing you stretches the biceps and forearms. Let your body weight do the lengthening.

items.name: 滑轮机旋后悬吊拉伸
